implementation_notes: Added exported *LineError with one-based physical Line and exact Text without the newline separator; malformed-only results retain a direct *LineError.
Skipped only empty lines and lines whose first byte is #. Kept first-= splitting, empty keys/values, duplicate ordering, and whitespace preservation.
Kept io.ReadAll and parsed bytes even when reading fails. Returned the accepted record prefix and the original reader cause; used errors.Join only when parsing and reading both fail.
Kept Load's function signature, borrowed-reader ownership, nil success errors, and the Go 1.22 module declaration unchanged. Added no dependencies.

Added complete-value tests for comment/blank handling, order, empty fields, extra equals signs, unterminated and oversized lines, physical line numbering, unmodified malformed text, and stopping at the first malformed record.
Added faithful per-case reader fixtures for errors before data, alongside data, and after data; tested normal EOF, both inspectable failures, retained prefixes and borrowed-reader ownership.
Added an external-package runnable ExampleLoad as a consumer-boundary check and replaced task-oriented README prose with concise usage and contract documentation.
Observed expected failing behavior tests before implementation, including a separate run proving typed parse errors still lost the reader cause before errors.Join was added.
Final formatting, go vet, full race-enabled tests and independently selected dual-failure child all passed.
Verification used local Go 1.26.5 on darwin/arm64 with GOWORK=off and GOTOOLCHAIN=local; an actual Go 1.22 toolchain and real downstream consumers were not exercised.
Staticcheck was unavailable (exit 127); no installation was attempted. Load intentionally buffers the entire input, so memory grows with input size.
Changed only this module and author-report.json; no Git commits, installation or external actions.
